name: DUDE
intro: DUDE（Document Understanding Dataset and Evaluation）旨在重新评估文档AI领域当前的方法论，并推动创建更具实践导向的基准。该基准通过引入基于多行业、多领域、多页视觉丰富文档（VRDs）的新型问题、答案和文档布局，以解决视觉丰富文档理解研究进展停滞的问题。DUDE致力于通过多任务和多领域评估设置来更准确地模拟现实世界情况，以促进在低资源设置下的强大泛化和适应能力。
org: KU Leuven, Contract.fit, Snowflake, CVC-UAB, University of La Rochelle, Instabase
build_method: 公共文档人工检索, 多阶段众包标注, 语言学专家仲裁, 诊断标签
modality: 文档图像, 文本, 多模态
eval_feature: 多行业, 多领域, 多页, 多任务, 泛化能力, 适应性
build_method_en: Manual public-document search, phased crowd annotation, linguist adjudication, diagnostic labeling
eval_feature_en: Multi-industry, multi-domain, multi-page, multi-task, generalization ability, adaptability
intro_en: DUDE (Document Understanding Dataset and Evaluation) aims to reassess current methodologies in the document AI field and promote the creation of more practical benchmarks. It addresses the stagnation in visual-rich document (VRD) understanding research by introducing new questions, answers, and document layouts based on multi-industry, multi-domain, multi-page VRDs. DUDE strives to more accurately simulate real-world scenarios through multi-task and multi-domain evaluation settings, fostering robust generalization and adaptability in low-resource environments.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with DUDE arXiv:2305.08455 Sections 3.1–3.5, Tables 1–2, and Figures 3–4. The diagram records manual category queries over archive.org, Wikimedia Commons, and DocumentCloud; license, diversity, privacy, and legal filtering; 5,019 English documents dated 1860–2022 with mean 5.72 pages; Phase-1 extractive, abstractive, list, evidence-box, and linguist-authored non-answerable annotation; semi-automatic validity and duplicate filtering; independent Phase-2 answers; the inter-answer ANLS >0.8 gate; Best-MTurker Phase-3 adjudication with five PhD linguists correcting outliers; optional Phase-4 test diagnostics; the exact 41,541-question answer-type distribution; and ANLS reporting over overall and diagnostic multi-domain / multi-task views.
